scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev -w @pokemon-universe/web"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && rm -rf .micronaut/test-resources && MICRONAUT_ENVIRONMENTS=dev PORT=8080 ./gradlew run -t --quiet
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/web && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/e2e
scripts.test: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run check:api-types && npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
